brief:
Israeli occupation forces raided Khallet al-Farra, a Palestinian area west of Yatta in southern Hebron, on Monday, according to Shehab Wire. The incursion into the occupied West Bank community sparked immediate concerns among residents that the military operation could be a precursor to house demolitions.

Local Palestinians and advocacy groups expressed alarm over the raid's timing and scale, fearing it signals an imminent campaign to demolish homes and structures across the area. Demolitions in the territory have accelerated in recent years, displacing families and destroying livelihoods in communities deemed illegal under Israeli military law. The operation adds to mounting tensions in the southern West Bank, where such raids have become routine in villages classified as closed military zones.
title: Israeli forces raid Palestinian area west of Yatta amid demolition fears
